why: From A to B the double line outside moves half a turn (180 degrees) to the opposite side, and the dot moves three sections (135 degrees) anticlockwise. In C the double line is at the bottom right, so it goes to the top left; the dot is in the lower-left section, so after three sections anticlockwise it is just above the right spoke. Option 3 has both. Option 4 has the right dot but the double line is on the wrong side, and option 5 has the dot one section too far.
trick: For a dot and a mark on a wheel, count how many sections each one moves separately; they often move by different amounts.
